summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 appended to ControlType, Tuple[ControlType, str] added to ControlCode union); rich/control.py (format-table entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and Control.title(title) returning an unstyled control with one title control); rich/console.py (Console.set_window_title, gated on is_terminal like show_cursor, returns True/False, no Windows calls, no exception handling); rich/_windows_renderer.py (elif for SET_WINDOW_TITLE calling term.set_title once per control); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200); tests added in tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked wrapper, "Hello, world!"). Nothing was run: per instructions I only read and edited files, so Black formatting and the test suite are unverified. No commit was made. Choices: non-legacy output needed no renderer change because control segment text already flows through _render_buffer; "show_cursor passes" was read as the is_terminal check.
